summary: AIxCrypto Holdings filed an 8-K on Sept. 25, 2026 disclosing a non-binding term sheet to acquire 100% of RobotCo, the parent of Faraday Future Intelligent Electric Inc.'s (FFAI) robotics business, from FFAI, the company's majority stockholder. Consideration is a stock purchase or reverse subsidiary merger; outstanding RobotCo options would be assumed and converted into AIxCrypto equity. A special committee of independent directors (Chen Shi, Jason Dodier) was formed with full authority to negotiate, reject, or recommend the related-party transaction. No price, premium, or close date disclosed. Watch for definitive agreement, valuation terms, and minority-holder protection.
